---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HANDOVERS (Phase 026): a completed physical handover of coin or goods between parties
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Each time the world completes a physical handover it records one Handover fact: the turn, the giving
party (`from`), the receiving party (`to`), the kind of physical action that moved it, the good (an item
kind, or `coin`), and the quantity. The world records what moved and where. It does not decide that a
handover was a sale, a wage, or a gift, and it does not pair handovers into trades.

HANDOVER_KINDS: the physical action that completed the handover. A kind names the world primitive that
moved the goods, not the reason a resident had for it.

HANDOVER_ENDPOINTS: what a party is. A resident is an actor; a purse is a fiscal holder of coin; a
container is a carrier or vessel with a name; the store is the town's stock; a merchant is an outside
carrier that unloads at the store.

HANDOVER_LOG_LIMIT: the number of Handover facts the town keeps, newest kept, oldest dropped first.
The report's counts are cumulative over the whole run and do not depend on this bound. APPROX: a design
choice (no seed or source gives a figure). It bounds graph size for a 100-resident town, nothing else.

give.description: A resident hands coin, a held stock pile, or a held item to a resident standing on the same cell (give, or give_food, or a direct call).

transfer.description: The same physical hand-over as give, requested through the transfer action. The giver names the source and the recipient explicitly.

accept.description: A resident takes a held item from another resident's hands (accept with a giver).

fetch.description: A resident takes stock from the store, or from a container it can reach, into its own carrier.

put.description: A resident puts held stock into a container on its cell.

fill.description: Stock moves from the store into a container, armed by a resident's fill call.

empty.description: Stock moves from a container back into the store, armed by a resident's empty call.

stock.description: Stock moves from the store into a resident's carrier as an offer (stock_person).

give_newspaper.description: One newspaper copy moves from the store's stock into a reader's hands.

deliver.description: A merchant unloads the goods it carries into the store.

pay_obligation.description: One period's coin moves from the debtor (a resident or a purse) to the creditor, face to face.

collect.description: One period's coin moves from the debtor to the creditor, or to the hired collector as held coin.

deliver_collected.description: The hired collector hands the share of held coin it chooses to the creditor.

purse.description: A fiscal purse (council treasury, church funds), which holds coin for its holder.

container.description: A named container: a carrier, cart, barrel, or store vessel.

store.description: The town's stock, held at the store.

merchant.description: An outside merchant who brings goods to the store.
